name: Twisted bow
description: Accuracy and max hit scale up with the target's Magic level, up to +140% accuracy and +250% damage vs. very high Magic targets; reduced vs. low-Magic targets.

name: Dragon hunter lance
description: +20% accuracy and +25% damage against Draconic-type monsters when wielded.

name: Dragon hunter crossbow
description: +25% accuracy and +30% damage against Draconic-type monsters; additional passive damage boost at close range.

name: Craw's bow
description: +50% accuracy and damage while inside the Wilderness, decaying over time unless recharged with Wilderness Sword/Bow/Wand shards.

name: Tumeken's shadow
description: Triples the base Magic damage bonus of most staves/wands and quadruples it in the Ancient's Guild; also multiplies spell damage by 3x outside of raids.

name: Scythe of vitur
description: Hits up to 3 targets at once, dealing 100% damage to the first, 50% to the second, and 25% to the third.

name: Voidwaker
description: Special attack hits twice (magic-based) for a guaranteed minimum-damage hit plus a bonus damage roll based on target's current HP.

name: Phoenix necklace
description: At or below 20% HP, restores 30% of your max hitpoints and clears queued damage before the heal triggers.

name: Elysian spirit shield
description: 70% chance to reduce incoming damage by 25% on any hit, excluding dragonfire and poison damage.

name: Salve amulet
description: +16.67% melee accuracy and damage against undead targets, matching the common 1/6 strength bonus used by the item's tooltip and wiki references.

name: Arclight
description: +70% accuracy and +70% damage against demons, while also counting as a silver weapon for relevant monster interactions.

name: Emberlight
description: +70% accuracy and +70% damage against demons; like Arclight, but permanent and without charge degradation.
